### Simon Peter Denies Jesus
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/simon-peter-denies-jesus
Passage: John 18:25-27
Points:
- Peter faces renewed questioning while warming himself, leading to his second and third denials out of fear.
- John intentionally contrasts Peter's cowardice before servants with Jesus' courage before the high priest.
- Peter's failure illustrates human weakness and the inability of people to stand in their own strength.
- Jesus went to the cross to atone for the failures of sinners who would betray and deny Him.
- Christians do not make themselves worthy of salvation, but are received entirely through God's unmerited grace.
